description: Builds interview preparation for a role and company, by application_id or job title and company. Uses AI credits.

application_id.description: The application whose job the prep is for (an id from getmattered_get_applications). Replaces job_title and company_name.

company_name.description: Name of the company. Used with job_title, or replaced by application_id.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description (optional but recommended for better results)

job_title.description: Title of the position (e.g. "Senior Software Engineer"). Used with company_name, or replaced by application_id.

name: getmattered_generate_interview_questions

setupStep.description: Set while account setup is open: the step to take first.

title: Generate Interview Questions
